ScaleMyMealPrep.answer:
Shopify: On one of my DTC brands, I noticed post-purchase revenue per order was low. I identified that the checkout experience ended at the confirmation page with no further engagement. I implemented a post-purchase upsell flow and built complementary product bundles in Shopify, which increased average order value and improved backend profitability without increasing ad spend.

Meta Ads: A campaign had plateaued in ROAS. I restructured it by separating audience avatars into distinct ad sets and systematically testing different desires and creative angles per avatar. Once I identified the highest-performing combinations, I cut the underperformers and scaled budget to the winners — which broke the plateau and improved ROAS.

Marketech Digital Solutions.answer: I look at revenue attributed, open rate, click rate, and unsubscribe rate first. In one campaign, strong open rates but weak click rates told me the subject line was working but the body copy or offer wasn't landing. I tested a revised CTA and simplified offer in the next send, which moved the click rate materially.
